summary: BEST NORGE BYGG AS (org. no. 818 338 732) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2017-01-09. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 43.340 (Maler- og glassarbeid). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 2.7 m and net income was NOK 351 356. Board chair: Akbar Ali.
